caption: The drawing shows an arch-shaped arrangement of white flowers and green leaves set against a plain, light-colored background. The flowers have five white petals each, yellow stamens at their centers, and are depicted in various stages of bloom, from closed buds to fully open blossoms. The leaves are mostly oval-shaped with pointed tips, predominantly dark green with patches of lighter green and white. Some stems and unopened flower buds are visible at both ends of the arch. The composition is concentrated near the top center of the page, with the rest of the space largely empty. There is small text with numerals and a signature in the lower left and right corners.
title: Costume Accessory (Orange Blossoms)
